title: Design System: Archel Taneka — Underwater Landing

specialization.purpose: Compact specialization bullets inside the identity badge.

shadows.name: mobile-menu-text
shadows.purpose: Unselected mobile navigation over illustration; text-shadow, not box-shadow.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Supporting interaction easing; entry uses cubic-bezier(.12,.8,.16,1).

motion.name: character-dive
motion.purpose: Translation, rotation and scale settle to neutral.

motion.name: identity-dive
motion.purpose: Impact-card entry; reserved About identity retains its own 950ms entrance.

motion.name: menu-dive
motion.purpose: Skew, rotation and translation; cancelled on input, retired after entry.

motion.name: dive-wash
motion.purpose: Original page-entry water; unmounts at completion.

motion.name: dive-ripple
motion.purpose: Irregular SVG opening expands vertically through water.

motion.name: character-float
motion.purpose: Neutral endpoints; Y -4px to 3px, X within 1px, rotation -.12deg to .1deg.

motion.name: selection-pulse
motion.purpose: Independent 1–2px backing drift; menu text remains stationary.

motion.name: bubble-rise
motion.purpose: Ten fixed seeds; restrained opacity and 4–13px sizes.

motion.name: pause
motion.purpose: All descendants/pseudo-elements. Hidden document also pauses; input dismisses entry.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All landing descendants and pseudo-elements; hide entry and motion button, keep static bubbles, use automatic scroll.

mobile.purpose: Identity, menu, status, and contact in document flow; illustration crops right.

character.purpose: Fill the stage height with proportional cropping and overscan for the float animation; crop beyond the left on tablet and the right on mobile.

environment.waterGradient: radial-gradient(ellipse at var(--hair-x) var(--hair-y), var(--hair-blue) 0%, #002bb8eb 18%, transparent 62%), linear-gradient(180deg, #7df7f2 0%, #27badf 12%, #087bca 28%, #084bb2 47%, #082a83 70%, #03175c 100%)
environment.purpose: Bright turquoise surface darkens into blue depth, with a localized field sampled from the current illustration hair.

interaction.navigation: Native links/buttons and Tab; no custom Arrow/Enter handling or hints.
interaction.reservedAbout: AboutIdentity.jsx preserves the unmounted name/photo easter eggs and prior identity content.

characterFloat.accessibility: Pause or hidden document freezes motion; reduced motion disables it.

poolDiveEntrance.technique: original SVG masked water sheets; CSS transforms; one frame callback aligns React deadlines

narrative.overview:
The underwater main menu moves from a bright turquoise surface through cobalt water to deep navy. Reflections, drifting rays, rising bubbles, and the original transparent character establish depth. Condensed, tilted navigation carries the expressive energy; upright supporting text keeps identity, specialization, resume access, and contact readable.

This document describes the landing mounted by `src/App.jsx`, grounded in `src/components/landing/` and the approved `.impeccable/surfaces/src-app-jsx.md` contract. Existing section components and factual data remain preserved but unmounted. The former Decision Journal documentation remains archived and does not govern this surface.
keyCharacteristics: Bright surface reflections descend into a deep blue underwater stage.
The original transparent illustration sits closely beside oversized angled navigation.
A vertical name ribbon occupies the far left; identity and specialization share a compact badge.
A visible, nonblocking dive entrance settles into float, bubble, light, and selection motion.

rules.name: The Upright Support Rule
rules.body: Rotate expressive menu entries, but keep identity and supporting paragraphs upright.

rules.name: The Interruptible Water Rule
rules.body: Keep content immediately usable, and let visitors stop every animated layer.

dos: Do use the supplied original illustration and the original identity portrait with its alternate photos.
Do keep supporting text upright, readable, and clear of illustration and menu silhouettes.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, native resume/contact links, and reduced-motion support.
Do preserve all four easter eggs: Chinese name, keyboard photos, console output, and tab/window title.
Do keep the landing-only scope explicit and preserve existing section components and factual data.
donts: Don't ship reference game artwork, logos, characters, or icons.
Don't hide essential access behind hover or a blocking opening sequence.
Don't present the unbuilt menu destinations as completed pages.
Don't apply the archived Decision Journal palette or component rules to this landing.
